descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: real-device variant.

Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S20 Dictated custom question on a real phone, both contexts (local stack only)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 A dictated custom question is answered correctly. (UAT TC-15; TFA-92593 AC 5)
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home contexts (ground rule 3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92593 AC 9)
  • U12 Each Ask AI call records the model that answered (fellBackFrom on a fallback) and the AI call time separately from the total; a dictated question records the speech-to-text engine. (UAT 3.1; UAT 3.5; UAT 3.9)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Phone build pointed at the local stack, fresh @roundai.test account; a Hospital patient with labs (S01 data) and an NH resident with a held drug (S02 NH variant data)

When Dictate "What's the potassium?" on the Hospital chart and "Is she on lisinopril right now?" on the resident; with the keyboard up, check the input stays visible

Then The transcribed question appears in full before Ask; the answers quote K 3.9 and 'held'; the keyboard does not cover the input

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Tester confirms the transcription and that the answer is grounded; evidence records the speech-to-text engine (gpt-live, or Deepgram if ambient is on) and the answering model per 3.9. The dictation wiring itself is S24

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-15.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-15 Ask AI · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-15/S20

Tickets: TFA-92593 Ask AI (ready for qa)

Detail:

Android rig: debug build of main e02167f bundled for the LOCAL stack only (bundle names 127.0.0.1:4510/4511, reached through adb reverse), built outside the checkout, on the rc_api36 emulator (Pixel 7, Android 16); Playwright attached to the app's own WebView; every ai/* action the app sends is answered or failed at the WebView's socket (no model call; aiCallLog had no new row in any run). Done on the emulator, 2/2 passed: a real tap in the Ask AI question box opens the on-screen keyboard and the box stays visible above it with the typed question kept (Hospital chart and Nursing Home resident). Left: the dictated question (needs a real voice into a real phone and the live transcription session, which the local stack must not open) and the grounded answers quoting K 3.9 and 'held' (needs the live model), plus the engine / model record (3.9).

Evidence: 3 attached.

Dev run: skipped: set-aside — set-aside: iOS/Android; dictation by microphone/speaker (Quinn 2026-10-14) — Dictation by a real microphone on a real iPhone / Android phone: microphone, iOS and Android are set aside for the dev run (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
